raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification Above 25%
raw_entities.description: KYC verification requirement to identify and verify beneficial owners with ownership stakes above 25%. This is a core assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: beneficial ownership above 25%

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Evidence for Initial Deposits
raw_entities.description: KYC verification requirement to collect and assess evidence of the source of funds for initial deposits exceeding £10,000. This is a mandatory assessed topic in the training program.
context: source-of-funds evidence for initial deposits above £10,000

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Enhanced AML screening process for sanctions list checks as part of the assessed training topics. Staff are trained to conduct thorough sanctions screening as a core compliance control.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Enhanced AML screening process to identify and verify politically exposed persons. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Screening
raw_entities.description: Enhanced AML screening process to check for adverse media reports on customers and beneficial owners. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Referrals and No-Tipping-Off Obligations
raw_entities.description: Compliance obligation requiring staff to file Suspicious Activity Reports for financial crime and maintain confidentiality by not tipping off customers. This is an assessed topic in the training program.
context: Financial Crime referrals and no-tipping-off obligations

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Review Dates
raw_entities.description: Compliance obligation requiring quarterly review of customer accounts and KYC information. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering ongoing monitoring and periodic refresh requirements.
context: quarterly review dates and the account-activation approval gate

raw_entities.name: Account-Activation Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: Compliance control requiring formal approval before account activation. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering account opening procedures and compliance gates.
context: quarterly review dates and the account-activation approval gate

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Compliance Training Program
